module.name: holoscan-height-map
module.description: 2.5D elevation maps of point clouds on the GPU, in holoscan-point-cloud's layout: a fixed-size grid, fixed in the map frame or following the sensor's pose cell by cell, with per-cell elevation (highest, mean, or a variance-weighted Kalman estimate integrated over time), variance, point count, lowest and highest point and time since update, height and range limits and a clearing and decay policy; and traversability from the elevation: slope and roughness from a local plane fit, step height, a 0 to 1 cost and an unknown mask; with color images of the elevation and cost for HoloViz.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.
